SYMPTOM: Keyboard crashed on first switch to it on real hardware, iOS auto-switched to next keyboard. Second open works fine (process warm).
CAUSE: `needsInputModeSwitchKey` queries the host app via XPC. On cold start, the XPC connection isn't established yet — calling it directly in viewDidAppear triggers EXC_CRASH on real device. Simulator masks this because it handles XPC differently.
FIX: Wrap in DispatchQueue.main.async inside viewDidAppear:
```swift
DispatchQueue.main.async { [weak self] in
    guard let self else { return }
    self.keyboardView.showGlobe = self.needsInputModeSwitchKey
}
```
PREVENT: Never call needsInputModeSwitchKey synchronously — always defer it. The 0.3s delay approach was wrong; DispatchQueue.main.async (one run loop tick) is sufficient.
